topics.purpose: Define negative feedback as review-triggering evidence rather than automatic hidden point/Tier destruction.

semantics.feedback_rule: Negative feedback record has explicit identity/source/subject/Project refs.
semantics.review_rule: Applicable negative feedback enters explicit review workflow.
semantics.automatic_rule: Negative feedback does not silently reduce Tier without review semantics.
semantics.peer_rule: Higher-Tier peer review may reduce Tier according to explicit MeritCore policy.
semantics.evidence_rule: Review decision references exact evidence and reviewers.

invariants.rule: Identity, portfolio, merit, recommendation, trust and competence states derive only from explicit provenance-bearing evidence; display text, self-authored claims, ranking position or AI inference never become verified evidence by themselves.

Distinct canonical identities maintain independent evidence histories; merit, Tier, trust and recommendation histories are not mergeable across identities unless a future explicit canonical identity-merger contract exists.

lower-tier peer reduces Tier without policy
